title: Burnout Assessment
description: Burnout questionnaire across exhaustion, cynicism, and efficacy with scoring.
howto: Answer all 15 statements about how often you feel this way at work.
Read your score for each dimension and the overall burnout-risk band.

faqs.a: Exhaustion (feeling drained), cynicism (detachment from work), and professional efficacy (feeling effective, reverse-scored). High burnout means high exhaustion, high cynicism, low efficacy.

faqs.q: Is this the official Maslach Burnout Inventory?
faqs.a: No. These are original items inspired by that three-dimension model. It is a screening aid, not the licensed MBI and not a diagnosis.

faqs.q: What should I do with a high score?
faqs.a: Treat it as a prompt to rest, set boundaries, or talk to someone you trust or a professional. This tool cannot diagnose you.
